forbidden: You do not have access to these risks.

register.title: Risk register
register.description: The risks of every project you can see, most severe first.
register.caption: Risks across projects

critical.title: Critical risks
critical.description: Open risks rated at the most severe rating of the published risk matrix.
critical.needsMatrix: Which risks are critical depends on the published risk matrix, so none can be listed until it can be read.
critical.exposureNote: Open, assessed risks counted by their probability and overall impact.
critical.matrixCaption: Open risks by probability and overall impact
critical.criterion: A risk is listed when its latest assessment is rated {rating}, the most severe rating of matrix version {version}.
critical.noRatings: The published matrix defines no ratings.
critical.caption: Critical risks

empty.critical: No open risk has the most severe rating.

register.title: No risks yet
register.body: Risks are registered from a project's Risks section by its Project Manager.

project.title: No risks registered
project.registrar: Register the first risk with "Register risk".
project.reader: The Project Manager registers this project's risks.

matrix.version: Risk matrix version {version}, in force from {date}.
matrix.forbidden: You cannot read the risk matrix, so it cannot be shown. Reading it needs the configuration view permission.
matrix.missing: No risk matrix is published yet, so risks cannot be placed on it or assessed.

fieldErrors.identifiedInFuture: The identified date cannot be after today.
fieldErrors.reviewBeforeIdentified: The next review cannot be before the identified date.
fieldErrors.expiryNotAfterToday: The acceptance must end after today.

form.descriptionHint: Describe the cause, the uncertain event and its effect on the project.
form.categoriesUnreadable: The risk categories cannot be read, so the category is shown by its ID.
form.categoriesUnreadableCreate: The risk categories cannot be read, so a risk cannot be registered here. Reading them needs the master data view permission.
form.nextReviewHint: Optional. Not before the identified date.

assess.title: Assess {risk}
assess.intro: Choose a probability and an impact for each dimension of risk matrix version {version}. The server works out the overall impact and the rating when you save, and the assessment keeps that version.
assess.impactsHint: The overall impact is the highest of these.
assess.previewPending: Choose every level to see where the risk falls on the matrix.
assess.preview: Probability {probability} × overall impact {impact} falls in {rating}. The rating saved is the one the server returns.
assess.matrixCaption: Risk matrix in force, with the chosen levels marked

action.intro: Plan how the risk is treated. The risk's rating does not change until it is reassessed.

close.title: Close {risk}
close.openActions: Open treatment actions stay as they are: {count}.
close.history: Its assessments, actions and acceptances are kept.
close.rationaleHint: Say why the risk no longer needs managing. A rationale is required.

accept.title: Accept {risk}
accept.intro: Accepting a risk moves it to monitoring until the acceptance ends. On that date it returns to assessed.
accept.expiresHint: The first day the acceptance no longer holds. It must be after today.

start-treatment.title: Start treatment
start-treatment.consequence: The risk moves to treatment. It needs at least one planned or in-progress action.

revoke-acceptance.title: Revoke acceptance
revoke-acceptance.consequence: The acceptance ends now and the risk returns to assessed.

reopen.title: Reopen risk
reopen.consequence: The risk reopens as assessed, or identified if it was never assessed. Its closure rationale is cleared and the reopening is recorded.

start.title: Start action
start.consequence: The action moves to in progress.

complete.title: Complete action
complete.consequence: The action is completed. A completed action cannot be changed.

cancel.title: Cancel action
cancel.consequence: The action is cancelled. A cancelled action cannot be changed.

detail.notFound: This risk is not one of this project's.
detail.notAssessed: The risk has not been assessed, so it has no rating yet.
detail.otherVersion: The rating was given under an earlier matrix version and is kept as given. The map shows the matrix in force now.
detail.matrixCaption: Risk matrix in force, with this risk's levels marked

done.created: The risk was registered. Assess it to rate it.
done.stale: The risk changed while you were working on it, so nothing was saved. It has been read again.

problems.projectNotEligible: Risks can only be managed on a project that is approved and planned, active, suspended or completed.
problems.notInProfile: This project's governance profile does not include risk management.
problems.ownerNotEligible: The owner must hold a role on this project.
problems.identifiedDateInvalid: The identified date cannot be after today.
problems.closed: The risk is closed. Reopen it before changing it.
problems.impactInvalid: The levels do not fit the risk matrix in force. Read the matrix again and choose a level for every dimension.
problems.treatmentActionRequired: Add a planned or in-progress action before starting treatment.
problems.acceptanceActive: The risk has an active acceptance. Revoke it first.
problems.acceptanceNotActive: The risk has no active acceptance.
problems.acceptanceExpiryInvalid: The acceptance must end after today.
problems.actionNotEditable: A completed or cancelled action cannot be changed.
problems.configurationMissing: No risk matrix is published, so the risk cannot be assessed.
problems.invalidTransition: The risk's state no longer allows this.
problems.permissionDenied: You do not have permission to do this.
